item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently and directly revokes the cited executive orders as applied to the specified Japanese and Korean persons, removing the executive-order basis that precluded their lawful entry or remaining; the legal consequence occurs in this segment itself.","evidence":"I hereby revoke the said Executive Orders No. 589 of March 14, 1907, and No. 1712 of February 24, 1913"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Commissioner, subject to the Attorney General’s approval, is directed to take implementing action and issue any necessary regulations, but the segment does not dictate a particular later legal outcome.","evidence":"to take such action and to issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary for carrying out the provisions of this order"}]}
